name: Fake Address Generator
summary: Generate synthetic street addresses for tests and mockups — locally in your browser.
description: Create 1–100 fake addresses for US, Canada, UK, India, or Germany (or mixed). Use a seed for reproducible fixtures, copy formatted blocks or JSON. For development demos only — not real postal data.

faqs.question: Are these real addresses?
faqs.answer: No. They are randomly composed placeholders for UI and API fixtures.

faqs.question: Can I reproduce the same list?
faqs.answer: Yes. Enable a deterministic seed so the same options yield the same JSON.

faqs.question: Is anything uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Generation runs entirely in your browser.
